metadata.question: Does the Antarctic ozone hole size increase in September 2003 compared to September 2002?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to analyze ozone data over Antarctica for September 2002 and September 2003 - Best source: Aura OMI Total Column Ozone (OMTO3 or OMI/Aura_O3) - Location: Antarctic region (focus on area around South Pole) - Time: September 2002 vs September 2003 2. Masking strategy: - The question is about ozone hole SIZE, not cloud cover - Ozone hole is typically defined as areas with column ozone < 220 Dobson Units - Should mask for quality flags if available, but primary focus is on ozone values < 220 DU - Need to calculate the area (pixel count) of the ozone hole for both years 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: If ozone hole exists and we get valid area measurements - C1: If no OMI data exists for these dates (OMI launched Oct 2004, so 2002-2003 won't have OMI data) - Will need to use TOMS (Total Ozone Mapping Spectrometer) data instead - C2: If after processing we have 0 valid pixels - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - Compare 2003 hole size to 2002 hole size: if 2003 > 2002, answer A; else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const antarctica = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[-180, -60], [180, -60], [180, -90], [-180, -90], [-180, -60]]], null, false ); const date2002 = ee.DateRange('2002-09-01', '2002-09-30'); const date2003 = ee.DateRange('2003-09-01', '2003-09-30'); // 2. Data Acquisition - Try TOMS (Earth Probe) for 2002-2003 let col2002 = ee.ImageCollection('TOMS/MERGED') .filterDate(date2002) .filterBounds(antarctica); let col2003 = ee.ImageCollection('TOMS/MERGED') .filterDate(date2003) .filterBounds(antarctica); const size2002 = col2002.size().getInfo(); const size2003 = col2003.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2002 Images: ${size2002}`); console.log(`2003 Images: ${size2003}`); if (size2002 === 0 || size2003 === 0) { console.log("No TOMS data available for one or both years."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate ozone hole area (ozone < 220 DU) const ozoneThreshold = 220; // Get mean composite for each September const ozone2002 = col2002.mean().select('ozone'); const ozone2003 = col2003.mean().select('ozone'); // Create binary masks for ozone hole (< 220 DU) const hole2002 = ozone2002.lt(ozoneThreshold); const hole2003 = ozone2003.lt(ozoneThreshold); // 4. Calculate pixel counts (proportional to area) const count2002 = hole2002.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarctica, scale: 50000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ozone').getInfo(); const count2003 = hole2003.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarctica, scale: 50000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ozone').getInfo(); console.log(`2002 Ozone hole pixels: ${count2002}`); console.log(`2003 Ozone hole pixels: ${count2003}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count2002 === null || count2003 === null || isNaN(count2002) || isNaN(count2003)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (count2002 === 0 && count2003 === 0) { console.log("No valid ozone hole pixels detected."); console.log("C2"); return; } const percentChange = ((count2003 - count2002) / count2002 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (count2003 > count2002) { console.log("2003 ozone hole larger than 2002."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("2003 ozone hole NOT larger than 2002."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
